annotations.title: FHA, VA or USDA loan fees

description: The published government fee a program adds to an anonymized loan: FHA upfront and annual mortgage insurance premium (MIP) and how long it runs, the VA funding fee, or the USDA guarantee fee, from the agency schedules with their effective dates. A published fee, never an interest rate and never a credit decision.

ltv.description: loan-to-value, e.g. "96.5" or "100%", at most two decimals

term_years.description: loan term in years; required for FHA

va_exempt.description: VA only: a borrower exempt from the funding fee
